task: regression: log10(MIC, uM) for a peptide against one of 3 ATCC reference organisms
ensemble_method: simple unweighted mean of BiLSTM, CNN, and Random Forest predictions (not computed by the source notebook; combined here per export instructions)
esm_embedding_type: per-residue (last_hidden_state), BOS/EOS dropped, left-aligned into a fixed MAX_SEQ_LEN=50 slot with zero padding

genome_feature_scheme.name: NAC + DNC + TNC genomic nucleotide composition

components.NAC: mononucleotide composition, 4 dims (A, C, G, T frequency)
components.DNC: dinucleotide composition, 16 dims (all AA..TT pairs, normalized frequency)
components.TNC: trinucleotide composition, 64 dims (all AAA..TTT triplets, normalized frequency)

genome_feature_scheme.source: precomputed once per organism from genome FASTA files in the source project's genomes/ directory; stored as genome_vectors.json in this package (no FASTA files shipped)

bilstm.architecture: BiLSTM(esm_dim=1280, hidden=128, bidirectional) over per-residue ESM2 embeddings (packed by true residue length) concatenated with a GenomicANN(84->64->32) branch over the genome vector, BatchNorm, then a 2-layer MLP regressor (288->64->1)
bilstm.training: AdamW lr=1e-3 wd=1e-4, batch=64, up to 150 epochs, early stopping patience=20 on val weighted-Huber loss, best checkpoint restored

cnn.architecture: Conv1D(1280->128,k=5)+ReLU+MaxPool2, Conv1D(128->64,k=5)+ReLU+MaxPool2 over per-residue ESM2 embeddings (padded positions zeroed pre-conv), flattened, concatenated with the same GenomicANN(84->64->32) branch, BatchNorm, then a 2-layer MLP regressor (800->64->1)
cnn.training: AdamW lr=1e-3 wd=1e-4, batch=64, up to 100 epochs, early stopping patience=10 on val weighted-Huber loss, best checkpoint restored

random_forest.feature_composition: 319 iFeature protein descriptors + 84 genome NAC/DNC/TNC features

ifeature_descriptor_set.CTDC: 39 dims, composition/transition/distribution - composition (13 physicochemical properties x 3 groups)
ifeature_descriptor_set.CTDT: 39 dims, CTD - transition (13 properties x 3 transitions)
ifeature_descriptor_set.CTDD: 195 dims, CTD - distribution (13 properties x 3 groups x 5 percentile cutoffs)
ifeature_descriptor_set.PAAC: 20 dims (Xc1, amino acid composition term) + 1 dim (Xc2, lambda=1 sequence-order term), pseudo amino acid composition with lambda=1 (source project peptides too short for the PAAC default lambda=30)
ifeature_descriptor_set.vendored_from: iFeature (Chen et al., https://github.com/Superzchen/iFeature), reimplemented in predictor.py so no external iFeature install is needed at inference time; numerically validated against the original iFeature codebase output on multiple test sequences (exact match)

random_forest.training: fit directly on point-estimate log10_mic_um target (no censored-loss variant for RF; all rows, including censored ones, trained on their point estimate)

loss_function: weighted Huber loss (delta=1.0) used to train BiLSTM and CNN; censored rows (MIC reported as '<' or '>' a bound) down-weighted to 0.5x vs 1.0x for uncensored rows -- NOT bound-aware (does not enforce the prediction stay on the correct side of the bound), simply reduces the influence of uncertain targets

training_data.sources: CAMP + DRAMP + DBAASP, combined and deduplicated with CAMP > DBAASP > DRAMP priority
training_data.restricted_to: 3 ATCC reference organisms only (Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus, Pseudomonas aeruginosa)
training_data.split: 75/12.5/12.5 train/val/test by CD-HIT 90%-identity cluster (whole clusters assigned to one split, greedy balance of split size + per-split species mix)
